newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c.bank to cut main rate to 35.76 pct/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c.bank to cut main rate to 35.76 pct/yr.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) will cut its main interest rate to 35.76 percent annually from 47.28 percent, local bank dealers said on Thursday.
"The central bank advised us that the main rate will be set at 35.76 percent annually from Monday," a dealer said.
BNB officials were not immediately available for comment. An official statement may come later on Thursday.
The new main interest rate would give 42.24 percent effective annual interest rate calculated through accumulation of the monthly accruals, down from current 59.00 percent.
The rate cut was in line with falling yields on Finance ministry's four-week discount T-bills auctioned daily since Friday, dealers said.
The central bank adjusts its main rate weekly to the weighted average effective monthly yield on four-week maturities sold from Friday through Thursday at the primary auctions.
The average yield to maturity on four-week maturities auctioned since Friday ranged between 1.70-3.35 percent, down from 3.48-3.81 percent the week before. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 911 88
